notes.title: Oct 27, 2018 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixes cannot convert given narrow string to wide string error.
[*] Various fixes with Japanese text in menus.
[*] Stand Gallery black backgrounds fixed.
[*] Alignment problem with a single thumbnail.
[*] Fixed grayed out full screen options
[/list]

Please let us know if you are still having the convert given narrow string to wide string error. Include what OS/Locale you are having issues with. Also make sure you are running on build id "3254187".
